I currently serve on the coaching staff for Cal State Northridge baseball as their Director of Analytics. My team of student managers and I build the reports and tools our coaching staff uses to evaluate players, guide development, scout opponents, and assess recruits. I bring a unique blend of experience and technical background that I believe make me an asset to any organization. I am a former college player, coach, and data analyst and have a master’s degree in data analytics. I love baseball, am eager to learn, and work well with others. My goal is to work for a Major League front office someday.

## At a Glance

- **Director of Analytics at CSUN** where I lead a team of four student managers.
- **Former college player** at D2 Azusa Pacific University, where I was named team captain and won a conference championship.
- **College coaching experience** as a hitting coach, pitch caller, and first base coach.
- **Strong technical background** with an M.S. in Business Analytics from Cal Poly Pomona.
- **Run my own business** providing hitting lessons to hundreds of youth baseball players.
